operations.name: Vane Dart

expected.charges: Disobeying orders; refusal of military service (World War I court-martial of a conscientious objector)

updates.sentence:
Held at Fort Leavenworth; Alcatraz.

Court-martialed for desertion and sentenced in November 1917 to ten years at Alcatraz. This is the imposed sentence; actual custody admission, release and time served remain unverified.

operations.research_note: Homestead Museum historian Paul R. Spitzzeri explicitly describes Vane V. Dart of Santa Ana November1917 ten-year Alcatraz sentence. Contemporary Liberator 1918 also lists Vane V. Dart ten years (location is printed inconsistently); source-stated term is not entered as actual time served. Only sentencing MONTH added, no admission/release inferred. https://mc.dlib.nyu.edu/files/books/lib000003/lib000003_lo.pdf
